title: Chern-Ricci flow on Kato surfaces
summary: Let $S$ be a Kato surface and $D$ its maximal reduced divisor of rational curves. On $S\setminus D$ we construct Hermitian metrics which are flat along the leaves of the canonical foliation and study their evolution under the Chern-Ricci flow. For Enoki surfaces, we construct an immortal normalised solution which, on every compact sublevel of the natural exhaustion, converges in the Gromov-Hausdorff sense to the elliptic base endowed with an explicit flat metric.
